title: Proof of Stake economy under centralized exchanges--a mean field model
abstract: arXiv:2606.09003v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We consider the interaction between centralized trading and decentralized Proof of Stake (PoS) blockchain ecosystems. Motivated by the increasing dominance of centralized exchanges and the institutionalization of crypto markets, we study how trading activities on centralized exchanges affect staking behavior, token allocation, and decentralization within a PoS blockchain. We formulate a continuous-time mean field model, where the miners simultaneously act as validators in the PoS protocol and traders in a centralized market with price impact. Under suitable assumptions, we establish the local well-posedness of the mean field system, and derive a semi-explicit characterization of the equilibrium trading strategy. Numerical results suggest that centralized trading activities may enhance staking participation, and promote decentralization of the staking distribution through market incentives. translated_title: 中心化交易所下的权益证明经济——一个平均场模型
translated_abstract: 我们研究中心化交易与去中心化权益证明区块链生态系统之间的相互作用。受中心化交易所日益占主导地位以及加密货币市场机构化的推动，我们研究中心化交易所上的交易活动如何影响PoS区块链中的质押行为、代币分配和去中心化程度。我们建立了一个连续时间平均场模型，其中矿工同时充当PoS协议中的验证者和具有价格影响的中心化市场中的交易者。在适当的假设下，我们证明了平均场系统的局部适定性，并推导出均衡交易策略的半显式刻画。数值结果表明，中心化交易活动可能会提高质押参与度，并通过市场激励促进质押分布的去中心化。我们还研究了交易成本的影响。
tldr: 该论文建立了一个连续时间平均场模型，研究中心化交易所交易活动与PoS区块链质押行为的相互作用，发现中心化交易可能通过市场激励提高质押参与度并促进质押分布的去中心化。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a continuous-time mean field model capturing the interaction between centralized exchange trading and PoS blockchain staking, finding that centralized trading activities may enhance staking participation and promote decentralization of the staking distribution through market incentives.
